measurements.severity_stated_by_source: NOT_REPORTED — the label assigns no severity grade to these table entries. It lists them under the heading 'Common Ocular Adverse Reactions (≥2%) and greater than Sham in Study Eye', which is a frequency descriptor, not a severity grade, and haemorrhage terms are NOT among the events the label calls 'potentially serious adverse reactions' in section 6.

measurements.verbatim_quote: Table 1: Common Ocular Adverse Reactions (≥2%) and greater than Sham in Study Eye up to 12 months 1 Blurred vision includes visual impairment, vision blurred, visual acuity reduced, visual acuity reduced transiently. Adverse Drug Reactions IZERVAY N=292 Sham N=332 Conjunctival hemorrhage 13% 9%
measurements.notes: Denominator-bearing, concurrently sham-controlled INCIDENCE from the approved US label — this is NOT FAERS and must not be pooled with the S2/S3/S4 spontaneous-report rows. Percentages are printed to whole percent only; no counts, confidence intervals, p-values or severity grades are given for these adverse-reaction table entries, and the label states no causal attribution for the haemorrhage terms. CONFOUNDERS the reviewer must carry: (a) all events are OCULAR and follow an intravitreal injection, so they are plausibly procedural/mechanical rather than evidence of a systemic coagulation defect; (b) the label never defines what the sham procedure was; (c) section 14 states 'At any time during the GATHER2 study, patients that developed choroidal neovascularization were concomitantly treated with anti-VEGF therapy', and anti-VEGF intravitreal injection is itself a cause of conjunctival haemorrhage. No systemic coagulation laboratory parameter is reported anywhere in this label (see the absence row).

measurements.verbatim_quote: The most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥ 5%) were conjunctival hemorrhage, increased IOP, blurred vision, neovascular age-related macular degeneration, punctate keratitis, and eye pain ( 6.1 )
measurements.notes: ABSENCE / REGULATORY SILENCE — NOT a measured null. A full-text scan of every field in this openFDA label record returns ZERO occurrences of: coagul*, aPTT, thromboplastin, prothrombin, INR, normalised, normalized, fibrinogen, D-dimer, thrombin, antithrombin, anti-Xa, bleed*, platelet, thrombocyt*, clotting, thrombo*, epistaxis, ecchymo*, bruis*, anticoagul*, warfarin, heparin. The only stem that matches at all is 'hemorrhag' (8 hits), and every one of those is an OCULAR event term. The label therefore NEVER states that systemic coagulation was measured and found normal — it simply never mentions the endpoint. effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED, not 'no_change'; do not score this as a negative finding.

measurements.system_model: FAERS (FDA Adverse Event Reporting System) spontaneous post-marketing reports, queried through the openFDA drug/event API; disproportionality computed against all other drugs in FAERS (grand total 20692690 reports at query time)
measurements.n_subjects: NOT_APPLICABLE — FAERS counts REPORTS, not enumerated subjects, and has no exposed-population denominator. The drug's total FAERS report count is 44, which is a reporting volume, not a number of treated patients.
measurements.control_description: disproportionality comparator, NOT a matched control group: the number of FAERS reports carrying MedDRA PT 'ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED' across ALL drugs (264 reports), against a FAERS grand total of 20692690 reports.
measurements.effect_vs_control: PRR 1788.17; Yates chi-square 444.4; source's own signal flag (a>=3 AND PRR>=2 AND chi2>=4) = False. The MedDRA term itself encodes a fall in antithrombin III, but no laboratory value, unit or reference range exists in FAERS, so no measured effect direction can be recorded.
measurements.source_locus: faers_coag_signal_table.csv, data row 1 of 57 (file line 2); compound=fitusiran, meddra_pt=ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED
measurements.verbatim_quote: fitusiran,ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED,1,44,264,20692690,1788.17,444.4,False,"https://api.fda.gov/drug/event.json?search=patient.drug.openfda.substance_name:""fitusiran""+AND+patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact:""ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED""&limit=1"
measurements.notes: FAERS SPONTANEOUS REPORTING LIMITATION: this value is a COUNT OF REPORTS, not a rate. FAERS has NO DENOMINATOR (the number of patients exposed is unknown), reporting is voluntary and incomplete, reports are subject to duplication, stimulated/notoriety reporting and channelling, and a report is not evidence that the drug caused the event. This row must never be read as an incidence, a prevalence, or a measured null. EXACT QUERY THAT PRODUCED THIS COUNT: https://api.fda.gov/drug/event.json?search=patient.drug.openfda.substance_name:"fitusiran"+AND+patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact:"ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED"&limit=1 . ON-TARGET. Fitusiran is an antithrombin (SERPINC1)-directed GalNAc-siRNA; lowering antithrombin III IS its intended pharmacology. Basis for the flag is the drug's established mechanism plus the S3 case record printing drugindication 'Factor VIII deficiency' / 'Factor IX deficiency'; the CSV itself states no mechanism. INSTABILITY: this cell rests on a SINGLE report (a=1); the PRR of 1788.17 and chi-square of 444.4 are computed from an expected cell count far below 1 and are statistically meaningless — the source's own signal flag is correctly False. MACUGEN entries on this report: primary-suspect MACUGEN; non-primary-suspect none. CONFOUND: pegaptanib is delivered by intravitreal injection into an elderly AMD population (ages printed here are 76, 77, 78 and 84) in which warfarin and antiplatelet use is common; the record does not list concomitant medications other than the MACUGEN entries, so an anticoagulant co-exposure can be neither confirmed nor excluded. This is not evidence of a systemic pegaptanib coagulation effect. extraction_notes:
SCOPE. Four files, two evidence classes that MUST NOT be pooled.
(1) S1 = the IZERVAY (avacincaptad pegol) openFDA label record: a denominator-bearing, concurrently
    sham-controlled INCIDENCE from two randomized double-masked trials. 5 rows.
(2) S2/S3/S4 = FAERS spontaneous reporting: COUNTS OF REPORTS with NO DENOMINATOR. Every FAERS row here is
    readout_is_qualitative true, carries the spontaneous-reporting limitation verbatim in its notes, and carries
    the exact openFDA query URL that produced its count. NONE of them is an incidence and NONE may be used as a
    measured null.

SOURCE RANKING. S1..S4 are ranked by evidentiary weight, not by the order given in the bundle: S1 (controlled
incidence) > S2 (aggregate disproportionality) > S3 (individual cases, ten drug x PT pairs) > S4 (individual
cases, one drug).

=== HAZARD 1: DRUG-ROLE ATTRIBUTION IS BROKEN, AND THE BUNDLE ADMITS IT ===
The openFDA drug/event index is FLAT over patient.drug[]. A query on
patient.drug.openfda.substance_name:"X" matches any report in which X appears ANYWHERE in the drug list,
including as a CONCOMITANT medication when a completely different drug is the primary suspect. A sibling file in
the same directory, faers_suspect_restricted.json (NOT one of my four assigned sources, but read as a
cross-check), opens with its own null-result warning: "This attempted restriction FAILED and must NOT be used as
a filter. openFDA flat-indexes patient.drug[], so 'AND patient.drug.drugcharacterization:1' matches any report
containing ANY primary-suspect drug, not reports where the OLIGONUCLEOTIDE is the suspect. Every count is
therefore identical to the unrestricted count." I verified that claim: in that file every
with_a_primary_suspect_drug value equals its all_reports value.
  I then confirmed the contamination is REAL, not theoretical, by reading drugcharacterization per drug entry in
S3. Of the 10 sampled nusinersen coagulation cases, 2 have ZOLGENSMA (onasemnogene abeparvovec, an AAV gene
therapy) as the sole primary suspect with nusinersen listed only as a concomitant:
  - safetyreportid 18565407 (DIC, fatal, 41 reaction terms): suspects = ZOLGENSMA; NUSINERSEN is drugcharacterization "2".
  - safetyreportid 20365486 (coagulopathy): suspects = ZOLGENSMA; NUSINERSEN x4 entries all drugcharacterization "2".
Both are counted inside the S2 signal-table numerators for nusinersen. The nusinersen aPTT-prolonged signal
(a=19, PRR 10.28, chi2 149.5, flagged) and the DIC/coagulopathy counts are therefore UPPER BOUNDS on
nusinersen-attributed reports. Those two rows are individually flagged in their notes.

=== HAZARD 2: CONFOUNDING BY INDICATION AND BY CO-MEDICATION ===
- defibrotide is given for hepatic veno-occlusive disease after stem-cell transplant, which is itself a
  consumptive, thrombocytopenic, bleeding-prone state; the drug is ALSO a deliberate antithrombotic. Its
  haemorrhage (a=155, PRR 8.78), aPTT (a=8, PRR 9.33), DIC (a=11) and coagulopathy (a=17) counts are the
  numerically largest in the table and are the least interpretable. One sampled aPTT case (20376804) co-lists
  HEPARIN SODIUM as a suspect drug — a sufficient alternative explanation on its own.
- fitusiran's HAEMORRHAGE count (a=10 of only 44 total fitusiran reports, PRR 45.59, flagged) arises in a
  haemophilia population whose underlying disease is bleeding. Fitusiran's mechanism predicts LESS bleeding and
  MORE thrombosis, so this is most parsimoniously confounding by indication / lack-of-efficacy reporting, and I
  set both on_target_effect and unintended_toxicity FALSE on that row rather than score it.
- inotersen case 22325931 is an LVAD patient ("Cardiac assistance device user", "Thrombosis") — i.e. mandatorily
  anticoagulated — which explains a prolonged aPTT and a raised INR without any drug effect.

=== HAZARD 3: SINGLE-REPORT CELLS PRODUCE ABSURD DISPROPORTIONALITY STATISTICS ===
The headline row of the table, fitusiran x ANTITHROMBIN III DECREASED, has PRR 1788.17 and Yates chi-square
444.4 built on a=1 REPORT. I recomputed both from the printed cells and they are arithmetically correct
(a=1, N_drug=44, background=264, grand total=20,692,690), but the expected cell count is ~5.6e-4, so the
chi-square assumptions are violated by four orders of magnitude and the number is meaningless. The source's own
flag (requires a>=3) is correctly False. 26 of the 57 rows rest on a single report; each is flagged in its notes.
This row is also the one row in the bundle where the endpoint IS the drug's intended pharmacology — fitusiran is
an antithrombin-directed siRNA — so it is flagged on_target_effect true, and it is a pharmacology confirmation,
not a toxicity finding.

=== HAZARD 4: PRR IS NOT A RATE, AND THE SIGNAL FLAG IS NOT A DECISION ===
The table's signal_flag_a3_prr2_chi4 column is the source's own heuristic (a>=3 AND PRR>=2 AND chi2>=4). It fires
on 10 of 57 rows. It is recorded verbatim in effect_vs_control and is NOT re-derived, re-thresholded or treated
as an adjudication here. Note also that PRR<1 rows (e.g. nusinersen x HAEMORRHAGE, PRR 0.37, chi2 14.8) are
retained: a "protective" PRR in spontaneous data reflects differential reporting, not protection, and must never
be recorded as a measured null.

=== HAZARD 5: QUERY-KEY INCONSISTENCY ACROSS COMPOUNDS ===
The table mixes two different query keys. nusinersen, patisiran, givosiran, vutrisiran, fitusiran, defibrotide,
imetelstat, eteplirsen, olezarsen and donidalorsen are queried on patient.drug.openfda.substance_name; inotersen,
inclisiran and pegaptanib are queried on the free-text brand field patient.drug.medicinalproduct ("TEGSEDI",
"LEQVIO", "MACUGEN"). The brand-keyed queries will miss reports naming the product any other way, so those three
compounds' counts are systematically LOWER-BOUND relative to the substance-keyed ones and the PRRs are NOT
comparable across the two groups. Compound names in the CSV encode this (e.g. "inotersen_TEGSEDI"). Separately,
the generating script pull_faers.py queries avacincaptad pegol as substance_name:"avacincaptad+pegol" with a
literal "+" inside the quoted phrase; avacincaptad pegol returns NO rows in the coagulation signal table, and I
could not determine from these files whether that is a true zero or a malformed query, so I recorded NO FAERS
absence row for avacincaptad pegol (see refused_rows).

=== HAZARD 6: DUPLICATE AND OVERLAPPING CASES ===
- S4 safetyreportid 5093151-2 is ONE report carrying both INTERNATIONAL NORMALISED RATIO INCREASED and
  PROTHROMBIN TIME PROLONGED; it appears in two query groups. The S2 counts of 4 (MACUGEN x INR) and 1
  (MACUGEN x PT) therefore share a case and are not independent.
- S3 safetyreportid 14422470 (nusinersen) carries FOUR separate coagulation terms at once (aPTT prolonged,
  coagulation time prolonged, blood fibrinogen increased, haemorrhage) plus thrombocytopenia, so it is counted
  in several S2 rows simultaneously.
- FAERS does not deduplicate follow-up submissions of the same case; no deduplication was possible here.

=== HAZARD 7: WHAT FAERS PHYSICALLY DOES NOT CONTAIN ===
openFDA drug/event records carry MedDRA preferred terms only. There is NO laboratory value, NO unit, NO reference
range, NO baseline and NO time-to-onset anywhere in these 39 case records. Every case row therefore has
readout_value NOT_REPORTED. Seriousness ("serious", "seriousnessdeath", "seriousnesshospitalization",
"seriousnesslifethreatening"), reaction outcome and patientonsetageunit are recorded VERBATIM as the numeric
codes the files print; this bundle prints no code legend, so I deliberately did not decode them into words.
Note that the case files are internally inconsistent about these fields: older records leave the seriousness
sub-fields null while newer ones populate them with "2", and faers_pegaptanib_cases.json omits the sub-fields
entirely and carries only "serious".

=== HAZARD 8: INTERNALLY CONTRADICTORY LABS INSIDE A SINGLE REPORT ===
S3 safetyreportid 22071673 (inotersen) simultaneously lists "International normalised ratio increased",
"Activated partial thromboplastin time prolonged", "Prothrombin time ratio decreased" AND "Prothrombin time
shortened" on the same report — mutually contradictory directions for the extrinsic pathway. This is a
data-quality warning about verbatim-to-MedDRA coding in spontaneous reports generally, not a finding.

=== IZERVAY LABEL (S1) — WHAT IT IS AND IS NOT ===
Conjunctival haemorrhage 13% vs 9% sham at 12 months (N=292/332, pooled GATHER1+GATHER2) and 17% vs 9% at 24
months (N=225/222, GATHER2), retinal haemorrhage 4% vs 3%, vitreous haemorrhage <=1% with no sham comparator.
These are real controlled incidences and are the only denominator-bearing numbers in the bundle. They are
nonetheless ALL OCULAR events following an intravitreal injection and are plausibly procedural; the label states
no causal attribution for them and never defines the sham procedure. Section 14 discloses that GATHER2 patients
who developed choroidal neovascularization received concomitant anti-VEGF therapy, which independently causes
conjunctival haemorrhage. A full-text scan of every field of the label record returns ZERO hits for coagul*,
aPTT, prothrombin, INR, fibrinogen, D-dimer, thrombin, antithrombin, anti-Xa, platelet, thrombocyt*, clotting,
anticoagul*, warfarin or heparin; the only matching stem is "hemorrhag" (8 hits, all ocular terms). That absence
is recorded as ONE explicit row with effect_direction NOT_REPORTED and is REGULATORY/REPORTING SILENCE, not a
measured null — the label never says systemic coagulation was measured and found normal.

=== FIELDS I DID NOT INVENT ===
No sequence, length, backbone, sugar modification, gapmer design, conjugate, PS count, purity or synthesis
platform appears anywhere in these four files, so all of those are NOT_REPORTED on all 14 oligos. The IZERVAY
label prints a molecular FORMULA containing 39 P and 21 F atoms; I did NOT convert that into a ps_count or a 2'-F
count, because the formula does not distinguish PO from PS linkages. oligo_class, modality and target_gene are
the only oligo fields I filled from outside the documents (from the identity of the named substance), and every
oligo's notes field says so explicitly. The "modifications" array is EMPTY: no source in this bundle publishes
per-position chemistry.

=== ENUM FORCING ===
readout_category has no generic "coagulation defect" bucket, so MedDRA PT COAGULOPATHY was mapped to
clotting_time and DISSEMINATED INTRAVASCULAR COAGULATION to thrombotic_outcome (DIC is really a mixed
thrombo-haemorrhagic syndrome). readout_unit has no "count of spontaneous reports with no denominator" value, so
every FAERS row uses readout_unit NOT_APPLICABLE with the raw count in readout_value and the limitation spelled
out in notes; "n_of_N" was deliberately NOT used because there is no N. effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED on every
FAERS row: the MedDRA term encodes a direction in words, but nothing was measured, so recording a direction would
manufacture a result. "no_change" appears nowhere in this file.
refused_rows:
1. NO FAERS ABSENCE ROWS. It is tempting to write "drug X, endpoint Y, zero reports = no signal" for the
   oligonucleotides that appear in the query set but not in the signal table (lumasiran, nedosiran, golodirsen,
   viltolarsen, casimersen, tofersen, eplontersen, mipomersen/KYNAMRO, volanesorsen/WAYLIVRA, and avacincaptad
   pegol). I refused every one. Zero spontaneous reports is not a measured null: it is jointly determined by
   exposure volume, marketing duration, reporting culture and whether anyone thought to check a clotting time.
   Several of these compounds also have small total FAERS report counts. Recording zero-report cells as absence
   evidence is exactly the error the FAERS-limitation rule exists to prevent.
2. AVACINCAPTAD PEGOL x FAERS specifically. pull_faers.py queried it as
   patient.drug.openfda.substance_name:"avacincaptad+pegol" with a literal "+" inside the quoted phrase. I cannot
   tell from these four files whether the empty result is a true zero or a malformed query, so I wrote neither a
   count row nor an absence row for it. A reviewer should re-run that query with a properly encoded space.
3. NO INCIDENCE, RATE OR RISK DERIVED FROM ANY FAERS CELL. n_reports / drug_total_faers_reports is a
   report-composition proportion, not a patient incidence, and I did not compute or record it anywhere.
4. NO RE-THRESHOLDING OF THE SIGNAL FLAG, no EBGM/IC/ROR computed, no confidence intervals added. I recorded the
   source's PRR, Yates chi-square and its own flag verbatim and stopped.
5. NO SEVERITY GRADES ANYWHERE. FAERS "serious"/"seriousnessdeath" numeric codes are recorded verbatim in
   severity_stated_by_source but NOT translated into severity words; a fatal-outcome code was not upgraded to a
   severity statement. For the IZERVAY table entries severity_stated_by_source is NOT_REPORTED, because
   "Common Ocular Adverse Reactions (>=2%)" is a frequency heading, not a severity grade.
6. NO CAUSALITY LANGUAGE ON ANY CASE. Where a case narrative would tempt an attribution (e.g. the fatal DIC
   reports), the row records the terms and the seriousness codes as printed and nothing more. The two
   ZOLGENSMA-suspect cases were kept as rows but explicitly de-attributed rather than deleted, so a reviewer can
   see the contamination in the S2 numerators rather than having to rediscover it.
7. THE 26 CASES I COULD NOT SEE. The S2 counts total 386 drug-event report pairs across 57 rows; S3/S4 pulled at most 5 records
   per query group, so for six groups (nusinersen aPTT 19, nusinersen DIC 6, nusinersen coagulopathy 7,
   defibrotide aPTT 8, defibrotide DIC 11, plus every group never sampled at all) I read only a truncated sample.
   I wrote rows ONLY for records I actually read; I did not extrapolate the sampled pattern to the unread
   remainder, and the group total is stated in each row's notes so the truncation is visible.
8. NO NUMBERS READ OFF A FIGURE. The IZERVAY label references "Figure 1" for GA growth; no value was taken from
   it (and it is not a coagulation endpoint in any case).
9. NO PLATELET-COUNT ROWS. Thrombocytopenia / platelet count decreased appears repeatedly in these case records
   (e.g. safetyreportids 14422470, 18565407, 17535181, 18438069, 22325931) but PLATELET COUNT ALONE IS NOT THIS
   ENDPOINT and belongs to the separate thrombocytopenia dossier. Platelet terms are quoted inside the verbatim
   record blocks where they occur, but no platelet measurement row was created.
